Rum Cocktail
By: ravikumar
Published: Thursday, July 6, 2017 - 11:45pm

Ingredients




Honey
Pepper
Cinnamon
Apple juice
Rum

Preparation

1 1. In a mason jar, add in honey, pepper powder, cinnamon powder, apple juice and rum. 2 2. Mix this concoction and serve warm.

About

Most loveable drink in winter and even when you feel cold, here is the cocktail drink recipe to make you feel warm and energetic. Rum Cocktail is easy to make winter drink which make your chills.
